text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the Tracen Academy dorms, laundry is 
collected per room and left out in 
designated areas on specific days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving it like that allows the waste 
collection crew to pack it into large bags 
and haul it away in bulk—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's time to collect the laundry! Did 
everyone remember to put theirs out?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fuji! We just finished collecting 
from the Miho dorm, so she'll be here any 
minute!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, we've got to hurry. Looks like we 
have quite a bit on our plate today."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Looking at the full collection bags 
makes me feel deeply moved. Everyone 
really gave it their all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, yeah. It's proof that you gave it 
your all—covered in mud, sweating enough 
to wring out your gym clothes, and 
gritting your teeth the whole way."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A bag filled to the brim with hard work 
and dreams, huh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...I really hope everyone gets rewarded 
for their efforts.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you already have the face of a 
mother, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nah, you're making the exact same face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! But well, the same could be said 
for you, couldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If she's here, then without exception, 
she's an Umamusume whose dreams I want to 
come true!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. As expected, I really can't beat 
you.
